subject: M037 player product shell, UI toolkit, player/diagnostics separation, save/autosave workflow, settings safety, and software-defined input rebinding
acceptanceCriteria: Main and pause menus are coherent, pointer-operable, and use player-facing terminology.
Player composition does not expose or require diagnostics-only concepts or services.
UI layout, focus, modal, text-entry, scaling, and visible-focus behavior are stable and understandable.
New Game selects a JSON world configuration and seed without exposing a scenario or world-rule editor.
Tutorial entry is clearly instructional but creates the same endless game.
Manual save naming is pre-filled, editable, and understandable.
Save browser, Continue fallback, overwrite/delete confirmation, autosave interval, and retention are safe and clear.
Display preview, timed confirmation, rollback, and safe mode are credible and recoverable.
Input rebinding, conflict handling, reset, context isolation, and text-entry capture are understandable and recoverable.
Accessibility-baseline behavior is adequate for the declared milestone scope.
Repeated transitions do not visibly retain stale UI/world state.
Known limitations are explicit and acceptable for M037.
waiverPolicy: No implicit waiver. Any bounded exception requires explicit milestone-contract amendment before review and must not weaken save safety, startup recovery, input recoverability, player/diagnostics isolation, or accessibility baseline.
notes: Record the platform used for human review.
Automated graphical proof remains required on both supported development platforms.
Game-wide submitted-text/RDP compatibility is not required.
Later presentation/tutorial/distribution milestones own their own review.
